scope: Independent read-only review of paper asset capture, restoration, and build recipes

coverage.build_sequence: main then reviewer copy then supplement, followed by response; bibtex8 and repeated pdflatex included

fixed_findings: Restore rejects an existing destination and any destination inside the immutable source archive.
Restoration verifies a staging copy and verifies that the original archive did not change before renaming the copy.
Verification binds the archived QA to four TeX/PDF pairs and every QA-listed figure hash.
Final capture requires both integration flags, manuscript_complete=true and pending_manuscript_work=[]; it does not conflate manuscript completion with unfinished result transfers.
README rebuilds a new restored copy and re-verifies the original archive afterwards.

actual_rebuild.scope: Current NS-integrated working draft; K study incomplete. Fresh restoration compiled all four documents from relocated sources.
